svg.text: BARN HALL — MYLAR PANELS + SLEEPING LAYOUT
Panel build-out depth and 8 twin mattresses along the long walls
Panels project 2 1/2" off each long wall
East gable is a full-width mirror, no exit
MYLAR PANEL BUILD-OUT — 0'-3" (2 1/2") OFF WALL FACE
3 courses reach 8'-0"; 48 columns per long wall
4 per long wall, long axis parallel to wall
Removing the east exit leaves ONE way out.
IBC requires 2 exits above 49 occupants, so the
75-person load on A-102 is no longer permissible.
Single 6'-0" door caps this room near 49 people.
